study: Lesaux et al. 2014 (ALIAS academic vocabulary, AERJ 51(6))
delivery_evidence: PD = monthly in-person meetings with one of two program specialists (former district teachers) tailored to teachers' needs, plus on-site classroom observations; a password-protected website (electronic lesson materials + video clips) is a supplementary support resource, not remote PD delivery ('Professional Development' section, p.16-17 of MS).
test_alignment_evidence: Extracted outcomes include standardized independent tests (Gates-MacGinitie Reading Comprehension; OWLS Written Expression) AND six researcher-developed, curriculum-aligned proximal measures (Academic Word Mastery, Word Association, etc.); test_type mixes standardized_independent and researcher_made (Tables 1-3).
curriculum_evidence: Treatment is the ALIAS 20-week academic-vocabulary curriculum (11 unit-cycles, scripted daily lessons) that teachers implement; control = business-as-usual core ELA; PD exists to support ALIAS implementation (Method, 'Intervention' / 'Professional Development', p.14-17 of MS).
outcome_timing_evidence: Single post-intervention wave in May 2009 at the end of the 20-week treatment; no later follow-up (extraction timepoint 'post (May 2009; end of 20-week treatment)').
